reality_delta: The system changed from "loops without diagnosis" to "stops with diagnosis when it detects structural gaps." But the detection layer and the generation layer are the same system — same codebase, same LLM provider, same architectural assumptions. The diagnosis is a new output format, not a new capability. The round 40 failure was not demonstrably back-tested through the new logic, so the claim that this fixes the root cause is unvalidated. The reality being delivered is improved audit trail, not improved correctness detection.
main_concern: Epistemological closure: all five changes add evidence generation (diagnosis JSON, opposition matrices, hashed scripts, screenshots, contract integration) but none add independent evidence validation. The same system that failed to detect the round 40 loop condition now generates artifacts claiming it can detect such conditions. Without back-testing round 40's concrete state through the new diagnosis logic, there is no proof the detection boundary actually expanded — only that the reporting boundary did.
top_risks: Schema-satisfaction as verification: role opposition matrices and upstream challenge fields will be filled by compliant LLMs. Existence of the fields doesn't prove adversarial reasoning occurred. The system may now generate convincing-looking opposition evidence that masks the same underlying blind spots.

Convergence diagnosis as new failure mode: auto_rerun_allowed=false stops blind reruns but converts the failure into a different deadlock. If convergence-diagnosis.json is generated incorrectly (false positive structural gap), the pipeline is blocked with no recourse. If it's generated correctly but the fix guidance is insufficient, the system stops without a path forward — same outcome as the loop, just faster.

Missing round 40 back-test: none of the evidence describes validating the new diagnosis logic against the exact state that produced round 40's failure. Without this, the claim that root causes are covered is speculative. The system may encounter the same class of failure in round 41 and generate a diagnosis that still doesn't capture the real cause.
missing_evidence: Back-test of round 40's terminal state through the new convergence-diagnosis logic, confirming the diagnosis would have correctly identified the structural gaps and prevented the loop.

Validation that role opposition matrices contain substantive adversarial content (not just schema-compliant output), e.g., a rejected_upstream_assumption that demonstrably changed a downstream decision.
A test proving that a deliberately broken independent-browser-verification-script.py (correct SHA256, wrong behavior) is detected by downstream consumers rather than trusted blindly.
minimum_fix: Replay round 40's exact terminal state through the new convergence-diagnosis logic and confirm: (1) the diagnosis correctly identifies root causes, (2) auto_rerun_allowed would have been set to false at the right point, and (3) the diagnosis content is actionable — i.e., a human or LLM reading only the diagnosis JSON can determine the next concrete step without needing to re-derive the entire context. Without this replay validation, the fix is an unproven hypothesis.
